description: A real swipe, not a carousel. The track follows the finger, resists past the end stops, and settles on the spatial spring.

MUST: Follow the pointer continuously while dragging, with no transition on the tracked property.
Commit on travel past the specified fraction of the width, or on a release above the specified velocity.
Rubber-band at the specified damping past the first and last panes rather than stopping dead.
Claim one gesture axis only, so vertical scrolling still works inside it.
Decide commit from the travel it measured, not from a value captured in an earlier render.
Ship its pointer and keyboard equivalents in the same change as the gesture: chevrons at pointer density, and arrow keys.
SHOULD: Pair with page dots so position is legible without a gesture.
Settle on the spatial spring, seeded by the release velocity.
NEVER: Advance on a timer. Advancing is always a user action.
Ship the gesture without its alternatives.
